mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 10.0% triggers a market reassessment of economic distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 10.0%, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (supply) and housing starts (demand) signals a broad-based economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in prolonged recession risks.
failure_condition: The interaction of INDPRO and HOUST declines does not produce negative 60-day returns in at least 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), a decline in the federal funds rate signals an aggressive response to prevent economic collapse, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates policy support.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a tight labor market that supports corporate hiring and wage growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in stronger earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in residential investment (RSAFS) below 390,000 million dollars triggers a market sell-off in real estate and related sectors, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the housing sector's weakness spreads to the broader economy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS < 390000, or the Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in the unemployment rate signals a policy response to a severe economic shock, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in prolonged recession risks.
failure_condition: The interaction of FEDFUNDS decline and UNRATE rise does not produce negative 60-day returns in at least 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 90.0), a concurrent rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE > 8.0%) signals a supply-side shock that disrupts manufacturing and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates reduced corporate output.
regime_hint: supply shock with labor market deterioration
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 90.0 and UNRATE > 8.0%, or the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.02.
